description: Test suite for the sponge zones API endpoints, including spatial zone retrieval, filtering, pagination, cache utilization, and zone detail retrieval.

classes.name: TestSpongeZonesEndpoint
classes.description: Contains tests for the GET /api/v1/map/sponge-zones endpoint, covering responses, caching, filtering, pagination, and edge cases.

classes.name: TestZoneDetailsEndpoint
classes.description: Contains tests for the GET /api/v1/zone-details endpoint, including successful retrieval, not found handling, validation, and cache usage.

methods.name: test_get_sponge_zones_returns_geojson( self, mock_get_cache, mock_get_client, client, sample_zone_data, mock_cache )
methods.description: Verifies that the sponge zones endpoint returns a GeoJSON FeatureCollection with correct features and metadata.

methods.name: test_get_sponge_zones_uses_cache( self, mock_get_client, mock_get_cache, client, mock_cache, sample_zone_data )
methods.description: Checks that the endpoint utilizes cache on subsequent requests after initial database call.

methods.name: test_get_sponge_zones_filters_by_capacity( self, mock_get_client, mock_get_cache, client, sample_zone_data, mock_cache )
methods.description: Ensures filtering by capacity_category (e.g., 'High') filters results correctly.

methods.name: test_get_sponge_zones_validates_capacity_category(self, client)
methods.description: Validates that invalid capacity_category query parameters are rejected with 422 error.

methods.name: test_get_sponge_zones_pagination( self, mock_get_client, mock_get_cache, client, sample_zone_data, mock_cache )
methods.description: Tests correct handling of limit and offset parameters, including the metadata indicating more data.

methods.name: test_get_sponge_zones_validates_pagination_bounds(self, client)
methods.description: Ensures pagination parameters are within acceptable bounds and invalid values are rejected.

methods.name: test_get_sponge_zones_handles_empty_result( self, mock_get_client, mock_get_cache, client, mock_cache )
methods.description: Verifies the response when no zones match the query, including zero features and a message.

methods.name: test_get_zone_details_returns_single_zone( self, mock_get_client, mock_get_cache, client, sample_zone_data, mock_cache )
methods.description: Tests retrieval of detailed info for a specific zone ID, expecting success and correct data.

methods.name: test_get_zone_details_not_found( self, mock_get_client, mock_get_cache, client, mock_cache )
methods.description: Checks that a non-existent zone ID results in a 404 error with appropriate message.

methods.name: test_get_zone_details_validates_zone_id(self, client)
methods.description: Verifies that suspicious zone_id inputs (e.g., injection or XSS) are rejected with validation errors.

methods.name: test_get_zone_details_requires_zone_id(self, client)
methods.description: Ensures the zone_id parameter is required, resulting in validation error if omitted.

methods.name: test_get_zone_details_uses_cache( self, mock_get_client, mock_get_cache, client, mock_cache, sample_zone_data )
methods.description: Checks that zone detail retrieval uses cache on subsequent calls.
